purpose: Test whether V168's immutable CPU guard should be activated only when heavy incomplete-parent terminal demand exceeds the cluster's immediate node-level placement parallelism, preserving V159 behavior outside structural terminal overload while retaining V168's E20 protection.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.interpretation: The static CPU guard is useful under E20's structural terminal overload but unnecessary outside it. Current-window heavy speculative terminal player count has a capacity-scale separation: E09/E18 never exceed node_count, while E20 exceeds node_count in 979 windows.

candidate.placement_router: bit-for-bit V159 Hiku2/OCS queue-8 router for every admitted player

single_mechanism_change_from_v168.precount: before player admission, count current collectable terminal request-function players whose direct parents are incomplete and immutable function CPU work divided by mean node CPU capacity is strictly above one
single_mechanism_change_from_v168.activation_rule: activate the exact V168 CPU guard only when that current-window heavy terminal player count is strictly greater than current cluster node_count
single_mechanism_change_from_v168.inactive_rule: when the count is at or below node_count, admit terminal players exactly as V159
single_mechanism_change_from_v168.capacity_interpretation: one immediate placement-parallelism slot per node
unchanged: V159 nonterminal short-work admission at remaining work at most 5.5 and queue density strictly below 8
